title: Welcome to GraphQL Learning
description: An introductory overview of the GraphQL Learning Platform and what you'll learn

questions.explanation: GraphQL stands for Graph Query Language - a query language for APIs that allows clients to request exactly the data they need.

questions.text: What is the main advantage of GraphQL over REST?
questions.explanation: GraphQL allows clients to request exactly the fields they need, eliminating over-fetching and under-fetching of data compared to fixed REST endpoints.
acceptable_answers: clients can specify exact data needed
questions.hint: It's about getting exactly what you ask for

questions.text: What are the three main components of a GraphQL system?
questions.explanation: Query (fetch data), Mutation (modify data), and Subscription (real-time updates) are the three main ways to interact with a GraphQL API.
No, GraphQL is a query language and API standard. It works with any backend, whether that's a traditional database, REST API, or other data sources.
acceptable_answers: it's a specification, not a database
questions.hint: Think about what it actually is

questions.text: What will you learn in this platform?
questions.explanation: You'll learn GraphQL fundamentals through interactive Q&A modules, experiment with a local GraphQL server, and build real ETL pipelines using GraphQL data sources.
acceptable_answers: query language, server setup, and data pipelines
questions.hint: We cover learning, serving, and pipelines
